blocks.text: Word of the ships brought volunteers from Auric Reach and Veymarch. Repairs and fresh paint went on around them.

catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

properties: Most malleable of the Magneton types
Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons

visual_concept.appearance: A varied crowd of human women and men in ordinary travelling clothes and work coats, carrying small packs and lining up to enlist. Recruits are not prisoners; no silver armour.

objects.name: New Frontier’s repainted prizes
objects.description: Josephine, Serenity and Serendipity AFTER the page20 dock repairs and quick recolouring. Three standard round-prowed Bastion capital ships, now with CRIMSON painted hull panels, bronze structural ribs and SILVER Veymarch broken-shield/star insignia. They keep their original hull shapes, standard guns and distinguishing tower/engine arrangements; do NOT become three wedge-prowed Argonaut copies or gain its huge refit cannons. Fresh paint/repair crews can be shown during the dock montage.
constraints: Exactly three prizes, plus the original Argonaut only if the shot explicitly calls for the whole fleet of FOUR.
The old fleet reference supplies hull geometry only; replace Auric gold/navy flags with crimson/silver Veymarch flags after repainting.

objects.name: Veymarch banner
objects.description: Crimson field; Silver broken shield and star

palette.note: Material colour targets chosen to match the existing canonical banner; not sampled pixel averages or map/UI swatches.
palette.lighting_rule: Allow folds, highlights, shadows and reflected light, but keep the cloth in its named hue family and preserve emblem contrast. Do not replace the house colour with the scene grading or another house palette.

world_constraints: One image per request; no multi-panel collage or embedded borders.
Compose for the fixed holder. Do not letterbox or paste the old wide image.
Preserve character faces, outfits, heraldry, weapons, metal colours and scene counts.
Keep essential faces, bodies and weapons inside the visible crop-safe area and outside lettering zones.
No unsupported new lore, extra Type C suits, extra capital ships or invented character names.

Rovan owns FOUR capital ships: the original wedge-prowed Argonaut and THREE round-prowed prizes, Josephine, Serenity and Serendipity. Repairs and crimson repainting occur at New Frontier on page20 before the four sail for Oram. Do not show four copies of Argonaut or add a fifth ship. The three new prize captains are ordinary naval officers, not additional silver Type C knights.
Only FOUR owned capital ships exist in this fleet: Argonaut plus the three captured prizes. Respect the smaller count of ships requested for close-up shots.
The new prize captains are three ordinary naval officers, not additional silver knights. No Type C armour in these shots.
All raised house flags are Veymarch CRIMSON with SILVER shield/star. Fresh paint does not turn the standard prizes into Argonaut duplicates.
New Frontier is the conquered harbour. Oram is the next destination and is not yet reached or captured.

All airborne vessels are rigid mechanical bronze/metal Zeppelin-like ships. ANY wooden sailing boats or cloth sails seen in an old scene reference are obsolete errors: REPLACE them with small bronze Zeppelin commuter hulls, keeping background positions.

prompt: Edit ONLY the distant floating-island landscape and sky in this finished comic panel. Preserve the image dimensions, camera framing, all foreground ships and guns, every person and face, clothing, dock structures, all crimson flags and SILVER shield/star emblems, and ALL existing lettering and box/bubble positions EXACTLY. Do not redraw or move those foreground elements. Keep the same painted-ink graphic novel style and lighting. Replace the repetitive island/castle background with the following varied landscape: A distinctive exposed dark basalt wall at upper left, broken into jagged unequal shelves with sparse grass, one low plateau with scattered modest industrial roofs far behind. Most of the upper distance is open warm sky, not a swarm of identical cone islands. Keep all three rounded prize hulls visible. Avoid copy-paste repetition: each fragment must have different mass, direction, edge profile, geology and land use. Do not introduce extra ships, new people, new flags, readable signs or borders. Four capital ships remain exactly four where present. Important: preserve original canvas and lettering placement, especially all text inside the central crop-safe aperture. No watercraft or wooden boats. This is a background-only edit, not a new scene.
